user_request: Specify a usable measurement plan for this consumer pilot: value events, cohorts, denominators, instrumentation repairs, owners, and decision timing. Explain what the snapshot can support.

trusted_context.authority: Planning only. Household is the analysis unit. Successful joint use requires two members to complete the same weekly plan; a click is not value.

source_records.text: Thirty households were invited; 21 created accounts; 12 completed a first joint plan. Events total 42 plan_completed rows, including retries; stable event IDs are missing.

Manual reconciliation verified the 12 unique first completions. Eight households have reached day seven since first completion; three of those completed another joint plan by day seven. Four are not yet mature.
No pre-pilot coordination-time baseline or comparison group exists. Product owns event semantics; analytics owns reconciliation. A draft calls 42 events proof of weekly retention and time saved.
